verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for a database or lakehouse product, such as one inside a cloud console, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no assistant built into LanceDB to which a user can delegate tasks. The closest items are a plugin for use with an external AI coding agent and OpenAI completion UDFs, which are adjacent integrations or developer building blocks, not an in-product assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
